# PptxGenJS

Pinned version: 3.12.0 (matching the version used by `python2flow.html`).

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pptxgenjs@3.12.0/dist/pptxgen.bundle.js
Project: https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS
License: MIT; see LICENSE. The bundled dependencies retain their license notices in the bundle.

Kept locally so Flowchart Studio's editable PowerPoint export also works from
`file://` and offline. Keep this folder alongside the flowchart page when copying
or deploying the application.
